test_models_from_logs: run test.py with log directory paths to load and test all reconstructed ML models
test_model_from_default_logs: run test.py with no arguments to test models from the default ~/logs/compiler_gym/llvm_rl directory
load_models_from_logsdir: use Model.from_logsdir to reconstruct trained model instances from a logs directory path
run_model_test: call model.test() to run the testing job that evaluates checkpoints against test benchmarks
select_best_checkpoints: call model.test_checkpoints() to select the best checkpoint per trial by a given metric
